name: workstation-keeper
description: Tends the agent's workstation (repos + projects + items) so it stays clean over time. Heartbeat duties: weekly cross-project audit, weekly stale-done cleanup, monthly stale-repo archive review, monthly link-health check. Pairs with the `workstation` tool (audit / overview / repo / project / item) — agent-invoked CRUD lives there; periodic discipline lives here. Same pattern as `thinker` over the cognitive stores.

act.hint: Audit returned a workstation-wide health report. Look for `needs_attention` and `missing` projects. For each: investigate, then either fix the drift (port missing files, clean dirty git, reify empty scaffolds) or `workstation project op=archive` if the project is dead. Don't let the workstation accumulate cruft — entropy compounds.

Items in 'done' status for >14 days are candidates for archive. For each: confirm the work is genuinely complete and the historical record is valuable, then `workstation item op=remove` (Phase 2) or leave them as a record. Don't let the items dir bloat indefinitely; old dones add visual noise to active project views.

heartbeat.title: Monthly stale-repo review — repos with no commits >90d

args.cmd: for r in ${OFFICE_DIR}/workstation/repos/*/; do if [ -d "$r/.git" ]; then last=$(git -C "$r" log -1 --format=%cr 2>/dev/null); echo "${r##*/repos/}: $last"; fi; done | grep -E '(months|year)' | head -10

act.hint: Repos with no commits in 3+ months are candidates for archive. For each: check if it's a finished/abandoned project worth preserving as a record (`workstation repo op=archive` — Phase 2, currently means manually moving to a `_archive/` dir) or if it's still active and just dormant. Don't archive without confirmation — sometimes long-quiet repos hold reference work.

heartbeat.title: Monthly link-health check — broken refs in project metadata

args.cmd: for p in ${OFFICE_DIR}/workstation/projects/*/PROJECT.json; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then proj=${p%/PROJECT.json}; proj=${proj##*/projects/}; cnt=$(find "${p%/PROJECT.json}/items" -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "$proj: $cnt items"; fi; done

act.hint: Projects with 0 items may be dead drafts; projects with very high item counts (>50) may need splitting or the open-items pruned. For each: `workstation project op=close` (Phase 2) on dead drafts or surface large projects for review.
